headline: 228 of 244 open pull requests (93.4 percent) carry a red 'integrity' verdict produced by a job that never executed. GitHub blocked the hosted ubuntu-latest job for account billing state; the check reports zero steps and no runner. This is an instrument artifact of the same class as the external-runner defects of 2026-08-13T09:37+07:00, at repository scale.

failing_instance.name: integrity
failing_instance.github_annotation: The job was not started because recent account payments have failed or your spending limit needs to be increased. Please check the 'Billing & plans' section in your settings

mechanism.inference: Identical gate, identical head class. The only varied factor is the runner lane. A hosted lane yields zero-step failure, the self-hosted lane yields 21 executed steps and success. The red verdict carries no Frank evidence.

discrimination_control.note: Not every red check on the surface is an artifact. Four sampled red checks executed real steps on the self-hosted runner 'clay' and are genuine evidence.

surface_scan.reading: The bulk migration to the self-hosted lane already happened. The residue is 10 files, and one of them - frank-deep-integrity.yml - produces 93.4 percent of the blocked surface.

existing_repair_candidates.title: ci: restore Deep Integrity on current isolated self-hosted lane
existing_repair_candidates.integrity_check: success with 21 executed steps on runner clay

existing_repair_candidates.title: fix(ci): run Frank Deep Integrity on self-hosted Linux runner
existing_repair_candidates.note: competing edit of the same file; 564 and 565 must not both land

counter_explanations_excluded: measurement error: the zero-step count and the billing annotation are read from the GitHub jobs and check-runs APIs, not from a log summary
caching: no cache layer can produce a job with no runner assignment
test regression on main: the same workflow on the same head class passes with 21 steps on the self-hosted lane
runner exhaustion: runner 'clay' was online and busy=false at measurement time
memory note instead of measurement: every number in this event was read live at 2026-08-13T02:51Z
open_account_action: GitHub Actions hosted minutes are blocked by account payment or spending-limit state. Restoring hosted capacity is an account-owner action and is not available to the research entity.
next_actions_ranked: land exactly one of PR 565 / PR 564 so frank-deep-integrity.yml executes on the self-hosted lane
re-run integrity across the blocked surface and re-measure the artifact share
route or explicitly quarantine the remaining 9 hosted workflows, distinguishing accidental hosted residue from the intentional hosted-shadow comparison lane
